question: How does the BFP integrate with the eBOSS backroom operations for one-time assessment and payment in Davao City?
answer: The BFP integrates with eBOSS backroom operations for one-time assessment and payment in Davao City through a shared information system with OSCP/BOSS. This process is outlined in [S1] and [S2] of the BFP-CITIZENS-CHARTER-2022.pdf document. For one-time assessment, the applicant will be given a queuing number and an Operations Support Paper (OPS) will be issued [S2]. For one-time payment, the payment will be collected and an Official Receipt (OR) will be issued [S1]. The processing time for both steps is a maximum of ten (10) minutes [S1, S2]. The Person Responsible for the Fire Code Assessment (FCA) will issue the OPS, and the Agency responsible for the backroom operation is OSCP/BOSS [S2]. The client can present the OPS and pay the corresponding Fire Code Fees indicated in the OPS to proceed to the releasing window to claim the stub by presenting the OR [S3].
